findings.mechanism: SQL injection via string concatenation of user‑controlled warehouse parameter, violating 02-sql-injection.
findings.remediation: Replace string‑built query with a parameterized query: q := "SELECT sku, name, on_hand, reserved FROM items WHERE warehouse = $1"; rows, err := pool.Query(q, warehouse)
findings.arithmetic: The function builds one SQL statement (1 query). An attacker can inject a trailing ';' and a second statement (e.g. DROP TABLE). lib/pq permits multiple statements, so the request will cause at least 2 queries per request when the payload "'; DROP TABLE items;--" is supplied.
